paper.prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: two independent antique blank rag-paper texture panels for a Three.js natural-history book. Produce a 1536x1024 rectangular texture atlas, two equal vertical panels touching at the exact middle, no gutters. LEFT panel: full-bleed flat orthographic macro photograph of pale grey ivory handmade seventeenth-century rag paper, fine embedded linen fibres, subtle letterpress impressions without readable lettering, age spots mainly at edges, a diagonal crease descending from upper left, a soft shallow fold near the lower third, lightly eroded dark tan deckled edge. RIGHT panel: DIFFERENT independent leaf from the same volume, same pale grey ivory colour and exposure, different fibre distribution, several fine vertical old folds near outer right edge, a shallow horizontal fold slightly above centre, a small repaired tear near lower right, slightly different oxidised edges. Genuine tactile embossed fibre detail with restrained neutral directional diffuse light, physically credible thickness and crumpling, paper remains fairly flat and blank for typesetting. Each panel must be independently composed, not rotated or mirrored copies. No text, symbols, illustrations, ink, flowers, watermarks, borders, surface underneath, book gutter or cast shadows from external objects. Fill each panel entirely with its paper.
